name: pg-boss
purpose: Own PostgreSQL archive-job creation, bounded claims, retries, expiry recovery, and dead-letter mechanics required by ADR-0019.
alternativesConsidered: Project-owned PostgreSQL archive lease and retry tables
Synchronous blob writes inside data ingress
Directory scanning as the archive queue
maintenanceStatus: Pinned to pg-boss 12.26.3 and its published source revision; requires Node.js 22.12 or newer and PostgreSQL 13 or newer.
securityEvidence: Registry metadata, package integrity, exact upstream source revision, frozen lockfile, production dependency audit, and local PostgreSQL conformance are required for this adoption.
modifications: None; Agent Context Framework retains archive identity, authorization, immutable receipts, blob verification, and recovery policy.
requiredNotices: Preserve the MIT license notice in distributions.
